sources.claim: jev-preview is TypeSafe's official alias pointing to the most recent release (official or preview; currently jev-1.14.0).
sources.quote: The most recent release, official or not. Moves ahead of jev-latest when a preview build is available.

sources.claim: Current target Jev 1.14 has a default 64k (65536) per-request context and 32k per-question context, expandable to 262k tokens via TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Long-Context: true.
Jev reads natural-language text and PNG/JPEG images.
sources.quote: Jev reads natural-language text, sent as a string, a JSON object, or an array of text values. It also reads PNG and JPEG images anywhere in the request.

sources.claim: TypeSafe charges $0.042 per 1M input tokens ($42 per Btok) and output tokens are free.
sources.quote: You pay per input token. Output tokens are free. A Btok is a billion tokens and an Mtok is a million tokens.

sources.claim: OmniMux routes jev-preview through the embedded official typesafe@1.2.0 task plugin.

unknowns: alias_target_stability: TypeSafe states that jev-preview moves ahead of jev-latest whenever a preview build is available and does not publish preview cutover schedules or pricing changes in advance.
max_output_tokens: System One models return structured typed answers rather than free-form token streams and TypeSafe docs publish no max_output_tokens limit.
notes: Official preview alias currently pointing to jev-1.14.0, served via embedded official QuantumNous/new-api-plugins typesafe@1.2.0 plugin. Task billing expression: tier("base", u("input_tokens") * 0.042 / 1000000).

notes.zh: 按上游返回用量计费：输入词元 $0.042/百万词元，输出词元免费。
notes.en: Charged by reported usage: input tokens cost $0.042 per 1M tokens; output tokens are free.
